notes.title: Demo Updated - Turnbased Strategy Fest
notes.content:
The demo of Tactic Legends has been updated just in time to participate in the Turnbased Strategy Fest here on Steam! Here are the patch notes:

[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Self-cast abilities and items now auto-cast on use
- Lowered default music volume
- Updated price display based on localization (mobile only)
- Enabled the Legend Pass subscription (mobile only)
- Redesigned match loading screen
- Moved username and flag setup to login screen
- Added age verification to make sure kids aren't tracked by analytics and age appropriate ads are served
- Lowered character menu icons to not be blocked by the notch on some phones (mobile only)
- Added camera boundaries to prevent odd camera angles
- Added tracking for analytic purposes

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Regen potion freezing the match
- Ranked mode not showing as locked for new accounts
- Items missing after making a purchase from the item shop
- Ads not displaying (mobile only)
- Ability text on locked characters not displaying
- Improved reliability of some network events
- Day 7 of the daily rewards has UI sizing issues
- Loading screen not disappearing after making a purchase (mobile only)
- Chest opener not displaying after watching a shop ad (mobile only)
- Audio staying muted after watching an ad (mobile only)

There are still a few more bugs to be fixed so look for a smaller update in the next day or so.

notes.title: Steam Demo Now Live!
notes.content:
It's been awhile but I've finally updated the Steam client. This build has a redesigned UI to work better on a PC. Improved controls and gamepad support will be coming soon as well.

Feel free to play this demo/early access as much as you like, because all progress will save on through the games release!

Here are a list of all of the changes that have been ported over from the mobile versions: 
----------------------
September 4th. 2024

[b]Improvements:[/b]
- PC menu UI's have been reworked for PC in preparation for Steam demo release
- Steam API integrated
- Discord activity shows your in-game status and join code for private matches

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Tutorial could become unresponsive if camera angle was adjusted
- Legends data not loading on Android
- Added missing translations and fixed text size issues when using various languages

----------------------
September 1st, 2024

[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Loading screen appears when attempting to make an in-purchase
- Match loading screen will show your opponents level and profile picture

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Matchmaking wasn't working due to the recent cloud data changes
- Surrendering from a match will no longer award exp
- Ability exp will can only be earned from ranked mode as intended
- Losing a match should award exp as intended

----------------------
August 28th, 2024

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Main menu UI wasn't refreshing after replaying the tutorial
- Home button wasn't responsive on win screen

----------------------
August 26th, 2024

[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Unity player accounts are now optional. First time logins will be prompted to connect a Unity account for cross-progression.
- Legends screen now displays ability exp progress and next level upgrade effect.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Sprigg abilities no longer freeze the match.
- Unlimited back-to-back daily bonus reward fixed.
- Added missing translations.

----------------------
July 31st, 2024

All player accounts have been deleted in preparation for release.

[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Account exp implemented. Level up your account by playing any mode, though you'll earn the most for winning ranked matches.
- Ability exp implemented. Level up your characters abilities by using them in ranked matches.
- All map tiles have been upscaled to be less blurry and have more details.
- Irbis has a new casting animation when using his Cold Snap ability
- When opening loot boxes, you can now tap on the item to view its name and description.
- Lava particles in the tutorial level have been improved.
- The inventory can now be sorted based on item type.
- Added a transparent black background to the action buttons menu.
- User login changed to support cross-progression.
- Logout button added to menu settings.
- Tutorial button added to play modes menu.
- Reworked the cloud data structure to be more secure from exploits.
[b]  
Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Sprigg no longer stuck in Concentrate casting animation when he dies.
- Fixed certain audio effects not respecting SFX volume.
- Adjusted some text being positioned incorrectly when not using English
- Fixed a bug that caused the game to ask you to set your flag every match.
- Fixed issues where user data wouldn't load under certain conditions.

----------------------
July 2nd, 2024
  
[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Sprigg has a new animation for his Concentrate ability
  
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed issues with certain sprites showing the wrong animation or state
- Fixed some misplaced UI elements
- Fixed action buttons not being clickable when they should

notes.title: Major Updates to the Playtest
notes.content:
If you haven't had a chance to try Tactic Legends yet, now's the perfect time! You can participate in the beta here on steam with the Playtest, or you can test out the latest build on mobile (see: [url=https://tacticlegends.com]TacticLegends.com[/url] )

This latest build adds the first single player PvE content (kind of) in the form of a tutorial sequence which can be replayed. Use this mode to experiement with the game mechanics and try out the game without dealing with matchmaking queues!

Here are the full patch notes:
[b]Gameplay Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tutorial mode added (PvE) with ability to replay tutorial
[*] Ranked mode turn timer now only skips your turn instead of forfeiting the match
[*] Attack QTE meter now cycles 3 times instead of 2
[*] Addition of landscape orientation for mobile
[*] "Skip" button renamed to "End turn"
[*] Improved responsiveness on controls and adjusted UI placement on PC
[*] New music and sound effects added
[*] Taunts temporarily removed
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated graphical quality
[*] Better optimization and frame rates
[*] Updated character portrait UI
[*] Selector updated to change colors based on the contents of the selected tile
[*] Increased characters movement speed
[*] Updated UI text and descriptions
[*] Adjusted sound effect volume
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] A disconnected player will now surrender the match
[*] Multiple camera adjustments
[/list]

Please try it out and let me know what you think!
